description: This Java class implements an auto-closing SLF4J logger that discards diagnostic context after each log operation, ensuring no residual context remains. It wraps another logger instance and manages MDC entries and correlation IDs.

classes.name: AutoClosingSlf4jLogger
classes.description: A final class implementing a logger that automatically discards diagnostic context after each log call, wrapping another logger instance.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of AutoClosingSlf4jLogger, ensuring the wrapped logger is not null.

methods.name: setCorrelationId
methods.description: Sets a correlation ID for the logger, allowing traceability across logs.

methods.name: discardCorrelationId
methods.description: Removes the current correlation ID from the logger.

methods.name: putMdcEntry
methods.description: Adds an MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context) entry with a key and value.

methods.name: removeMdcEntry
methods.description: Removes an MDC entry by key.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the logger, performing any necessary cleanup.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the logger.

methods.name: isTraceEnabled
methods.description: Checks if trace level logging is enabled.

methods.name: trace
methods.description: Logs a trace message, with overloads for formatted messages, markers, and exceptions.

methods.name: isDebugEnabled
methods.description: Checks if debug level logging is enabled.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Logs a debug message, with overloads for formatted messages, markers, and exceptions.

methods.name: isInfoEnabled
methods.description: Checks if info level logging is enabled.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Logs an info message, with overloads for formatted messages, markers, and exceptions.

methods.name: isWarnEnabled
methods.description: Checks if warn level logging is enabled.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Logs a warning message, with overloads for formatted messages, markers, and exceptions.

methods.name: isErrorEnabled
methods.description: Checks if error level logging is enabled.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Logs an error message, with overloads for formatted messages, markers, and exceptions.
